summary: I2C-programmable CMOS clock generator, 3 outputs (CLK0-CLK2) from 2.5 kHz to 200 MHz, 10-MSOP; runs from a 25 or 27 MHz crystal using internal 6/8/10 pF load caps; I2C slave at fixed address 0x60 (no A0 pin on this package); core VDD 2.5 or 3.3 V, output bank VDDO 1.8/2.5/3.3 V
